answer: Identity verification demands continuous sequential modular squarings, anchoring our network like a sunken reef against Sybil adversaries. Because Wesolowski time-locks resist GPU parallelization, an attacker simulating multiple clones encounters an unyielding physical time bottleneck. Whether an adversary deploys a single agent or a sparrow swarm of impostors, evaluating distinct identities over the yarrow epoch requires genuine, non-fungible sequential compute.
